control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit - gravity exposure at CV-3103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on CV-3103 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CV-3103 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. CV-3103 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 3 November 2004 a near hit was recorded on CV-3103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
